characterization_methods: X-ray diffraction in grazing incidence mode (GI-XRD)
evidence: Spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) was performed for evaluation of growth per cycle (GPC), analysis of the uniformity of the process, and characterization of the optical properties. Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS) and elastic recoil detection (ERD) were carried out by applying a 2 MeV He+ beam for both methods. X-ray photoemission spectroscopy (XPS) studies were carried out on a Thermo Scientific K-Alpha system. The crystallinity of the CoPi film was studied by X-ray diffraction in grazing incidence mode (GI-XRD). Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images were obtained with a Supra 40 (Carl Zeiss AG) microscope. Time-resolved quadrupole mass spectrometry (QMS) measurements were carried out using a Pfeiffer Vacuum Prisma QME-200 connected to the ALD chamber.
